patches.invariant: Every durable write records bounded HTTP/body/ack diagnostics and a missing write marker is surfaced before acceptance evaluation.
Remote DHT replica stores execute in bounded parallel batches while the existing minAcks fail-closed quorum remains mandatory.
Peer-record renewals include bounded random jitter so class-scale nodes do not renew in synchronized waves.
Diagnostic stages checkpoint PASS/FAIL/INFRA/BLOCKED, continue independent work, resume from prior checkpoints, and remain fail-closed overall.
Preflight executes real separate TRUYN node-service processes and exercises topology, readiness, routing, DHT durability, partition/heal recovery and renewal.
